answer_1.quote: Automatic text summarisation can provide significant value in the generation of scientific lay summaries.

answer_2.quote: We report the F1-scores of ROUGE-1, 2, and L. Additionally, we include FKGL and DCRS scores of the generated output.

answer_4.quote: We perform an additional human evaluation of our standard BART baseline model using two domain experts... Using a 1-5 Likert scale, the annotators are asked to rate the model output based on three criteria: (1) Comprehensiveness ... (2) Layness ... (3) Factuality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate model output on a 1-5 Likert scale for Comprehensiveness, Layness, and Factuality.
